answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 7626 Country: Canada Title: When sleeping, how should one's left arm and legs be kept according to the Sunnah? Question: When sleeping, how should one's left arm and legs be kept according to the Sunnah? Answer ID: 7626 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1793/1492=B/1429) The Sunnah way is to sleep on right side placing the right arm on ground and left arm on leg. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
